ei.title: The Life and Achievements of Alan Turing, a Mathematician and Computer Scientist

fullPassage: Alan Turing (1912-1954) was a brilliant British mathematician and computer scientist. Early in his career, he invented the Turing machine, an elegant mathematical model of a computer, which enabled him to take part in the construction of the Church-Turing thesis, contributing to the concept of computable problems. During the Second World War, he helped break the secret German code of the Enigma machine. This work was of considerable importance in leading the Allies to victory. After the war, he conducted research on the first computers. He developed an artificial intelligence test, the Turing test, based primarily on the ability of a program to deceive a human by presenting itself as human. During his last years, he made important contributions to biology in his work on morphogenesis in nature.

questions.passage: Alan Turing (1912-1954) was a brilliant British mathematician and computer scientist. Early in his career, he invented the Turing machine, an elegant mathematical model of a computer, ①<u>which</u> enabled him to take part in the construction of the Church-Turing thesis, ②<u>contributing</u> to the concept of computable problems. During the Second World War, he helped break the secret German code of the Enigma machine. This work was of considerable importance in leading the Allies to victory. After the war, he conducted research on the first computers. He developed an artificial intelligence test, the Turing test, ③<u>base</u> primarily on the ability of a program to deceive a human by presenting itself as human. During his last years, he made important contributions to biology in his work on morphogenesis ④<u>in</u> nature.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① which: 콤마 뒤 the Turing machine을 부연 설명하는 계속적 용법 관계대명사 — 적절.
❌ ② contributing: 분사구문, '기여하면서'의 의미 — 적절.
✅ ③ base: 앞의 the Turing test를 수식하는 과거분사 based가 와야 함. 'a test based on ~'(~에 기반한 테스트).
❌ ④ in: '자연에서의 형태발생'이라는 전치사구 — 적절.
det.tip: 과거분사 후치수식: a test based on ~(~에 기반한 테스트). 명사 뒤에서 수동 의미.

He developed an artificial intelligence test, the Turing test, based primarily on the ability of a program to deceive a human by presenting itself as human. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① break: 독일의 비밀 암호를 '해독하다'. 뒤이어 연합군의 승리에 결정적이었다는 결과가 이어짐.
❌ ② build: '만들다'는 Enigma를 만든 독일 쪽 역할.
❌ ③ ignore: '무시하다'는 전쟁에서 중요한 역할을 한 맥락과 반대.
❌ ④ protect: '보호하다'는 적국 암호를 보호한다는 뜻이 되어 모순.
det.tip: break a code = 암호를 해독하다. code-breaker = 암호 해독자.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① invented: Turing 기계를 '발명했다' — 원문 그대로.
✅ ④ protect: 원문은 break(해독했다). 독일 적군의 암호를 '보호했다'는 연합군 편에 섰던 Turing의 역할과 정반대.
❌ ③ deceive: 프로그램이 인간을 '속이는' 능력 — 원문 그대로.
❌ ② contributions: 생물학에 '공헌' — 원문 그대로.
det.tip: break a code(암호를 해독하다) ↔ protect a code(암호를 보호하다). Turing은 영국군을 위해 독일 암호를 '깼다'.

det.korean: 수학, 컴퓨팅, 전쟁, 생물학에 걸쳐 영향을 미칠 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ cross the boundaries of mathematics, computing, war, and biology: Turing은 수학(Church-Turing thesis), 컴퓨팅(Turing 기계·AI 테스트), 전쟁(Enigma), 생물학(morphogenesis) 네 분야 모두에 기여.
❌ ① be limited to a single academic field: 여러 분야에 걸친 업적과 정반대.
❌ ② be completely forgotten in a few decades: Turing 기계, Turing 테스트는 지금도 유명.
❌ ③ only benefit academic researchers: Enigma 해독은 전쟁 승리에 기여하여 일반 대중에게도 영향.
det.tip: Turing의 업적 분야: 수학 + 컴퓨터 + 전쟁 암호 + 인공지능 + 생물학. 다분야 영향력.

det.analysis:

det.tip: 요약 = 다분야 업적 종합. 수학+암호+컴퓨터+AI+생물학.
